about_the_game:
This game is a confinement suspense and love romance escape game in which the main character, who has lost her memory, aims to regain her memory and escape from the room in which she was confined.

The charm of this game

◆ Memory Loss

You are the protagonist, a man with amnesia.

One of the game's objectives is to recover his lost memories.

◆ A Sweet(?) Life of Confinement with Him

He will cook dinner for you, his beloved.

As your cooking skills improve, your repertoire will expand, and you will eventually be able to make over 80 different dishes.

◆ Simple Gameplay

You progress through the game by clicking on interesting parts of the room to investigate them and making choices.

Various events will occur depending on the choices you make, and some events will grant you "Memories."

◆ Locked Choices

At the start of the game, some choices are locked. They will gradually be unlocked as you recover your "Memories."

Sometimes, the key to victory is to deliberately end the game in a bad way and gain new "Memories."

◆ Over 10 Multiple Endings

This game has over 10 endings, allowing you to enjoy a variety of tragic and happy endings depending on your choices.

◆ Three Unique Characters

The man who imprisoned you, his twin brother, and the mysterious person who calls your name in your dreams...

Each character features a unique character.

◆Suspense and Romance

The appeal of this work lies in the story, where sickness, darkness, and intentions intersect.

Please unravel all the darkness.
